name: The Flats
text: Main HQ. Three-story apartment building, the back stairs are the meeting spot.

name: Corner Store
text: Small store on the corner. Source of news and supplies.

name: Back Alley
text: Fast way in and out of the block. Only members know the turns.

name: Empty Lot
text: Open ground nobody claims. Used for meetups.

name: Old Garage
text: Garage on the border. Other crews want it too.

name: Small Plaza
text: Open space by the bus stop. Busy by day, quiet at night.

name: The Line
text: Border with the next block. The hottest spot.
